references.text: Balaam tells Balak's servants that he cannot go beyond the Lord's word, even for a house full of silver and gold. This is the same principle repeated in 23:26.
Balaam declares that he can only speak the word God puts in his mouth. This is the same obedience to God's word that he affirms in 23:26.
Balaam asks Balak if he must not hold fast to what the Lord puts in his mouth. This is a parallel statement to 23:26.
Balaam repeats that he cannot go beyond the Lord's command, but must speak what the Lord says. This confirms the message from 23:26.
The prophet must speak all that the Lord commands. Balaam's obedience in Numbers 23:26 illustrates this principle of prophetic faithfulness.
